single_question: Does the P2k-confirmed separated SawFM period attachment generalize outside its 20-80 us training range, and if not, is the boundary caused by physical sufficiency, separator transfer, or period-head extrapolation?

fresh_paired_data.paired_across_regimes: same receiver_noise_seed identities and uniform draws transformed into preregistered ranges

physical_controls.C2_exact_component: same period expert on the exact reconstructed SawFM component
physical_controls.C3_separated_uncalibrated: P2f S1 separator plus same period expert
physical_controls.C4_separated_calibrated: C3 plus frozen P2h affine coefficient

system_variants: safe ISRJ route with IQ-Grouped parameters

failure_attribution.exact_component_fails: period-head extrapolation or finite-window identifiability failure; do not deepen the separator
failure_attribution.physical_controls_pass_system_fails: predicted-gate coverage or compound-combination aggregation failure
failure_attribution.only_far_high_fails: report a finite-observation-window boundary and develop an analytic or censored period estimator on a new seed
